subject: English
passage: Woad blue was a highly prized dye among the Vikings (an ancient civilization from Scandinavia). The Vikings were famous for using this natural dye to color their clothes a distinctive blue. ______ the name "Viking" itself, some historians claim, may have originally meant "blue warriors."
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. "In fact" logically signals that the claim in this sentence—Viking being named after the color blue—emphasizes and supports the previous claim that Vikings were famous for using blue dye.
